name: vercel env
snippet: Learn how to manage your environment variables in your Vercel Projects using the vercel env CLI command.

name: Environment variables - Vercel
snippet: Environment variables are key-value pairs configured outside your source code so that each value can change depending on the Environment.

name: Vercel CLI Overview
snippet: Set the VERCEL_TOKEN environment variable; Pass the --token option to the command. Using the VERCEL_TOKEN environment variable is recommended ...

name: Pass environment variables to the vercel CLI build command - Help
snippet: The vercel CLI deploy command has the option to pass build environment variables, because the build is happening at Vercel.
